description: Rolled back Fraud Detection Engine canary deployment from v2.4.1 to stable v2.4.0 via ArgoCD, and added null-check unit tests for guest checkout sessions.
Overrode local CoreDNS upstream resolution to bypass failing recursive DNS cache and configured static fallback resolver 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8.
Doubled Elasticsearch JVM heap allocation from 16GB to 32GB and triggered shard rebalancing away from hot node es-data-03.
Cancelled intensive long-running vacuum operation on read replica and reconfigured wal_keep_size to 8GB to prevent replication lag stalls.
Implemented client-side Redis distributed rate limiter with local 60-second caching for carrier quote estimates, reducing outbound API calls by 85%.
Hot-patched coupon regex engine with re2 non-backtracking regex library and set maximum input length to 32 characters on promo codes.
Updated review spam classifier threshold from 0.70 to 0.88 and reprocessed 120 false-positive flagged reviews back into catalog.
Patched Payment API idempotency key lock using Redis Redlock with 24-hour TTL and executed automated credit adjustment batch for all 14 affected customer accounts.
Scaled Redis cluster from 3 shards to 6 shards and changed maxmemory-policy from volatile-lru to allkeys-lru with persistent key namespaces.
Rotated expired Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) p12 certificate in production secret vault and restarted notification pods.
Updated Java truststore cacerts with newly issued DigiCert Global Root G2 certificate and initiated rolling restart of Payment API pods.
Enforced discovery.zen.minimum_master_nodes = 2 in Elasticsearch cluster configuration and migrated master nodes to dedicated AZ quorum nodes.
Terminated blocking schema migration lock query, re-ran migration using pg-online-schema-change with lock_timeout = 2s, and added statement timeout guardrails.
Updated ERP ingestion parser to handle UTF-8 replacement characters on unprintable bytes and configured auto-quarantine for corrupted records.
Invalidated edge CDN cache tags globally via Cloudflare API, disabled zero-price checkout validation bypass, and contacted 38 customers regarding pricing error orders.
Fixed API Gateway client IP resolution by configuring 'use_remote_address: true' and X-Forwarded-For header indexing, whitelisting VPC CIDR ranges.
